label: D1 after an unrewarded trial, late in the episode, while the agent leans toward a1
explanation: Fires only at D1 steps (none at GO/D2), almost only when the reward input is 0 (prev_reward==0 holds 93% of mass). It needs a moderately positive a1-leaning policy logit (choice in [2.78, 8.07) holds 93% of mass) and appears only late in the episode (98.8% of mass at ep_trial >= 50, rising steadily from trial 40). Value is low-to-mid when it fires. This predicate uses only observed or model-internal variables and gets 91.8% of the mass on dev, but precision is about 0.38: many matching D1 steps stay below threshold. Using the upcoming action==1 instead of choice gives a similar but slightly worse result (F1 0.49). Requiring that the previous trial reached S2 (prev_state==2, typically a1 -> S2 rare unrewarded, after which a model-based agent stays with a1) raises precision to 0.50 (F1 0.60), but mass recall drops to 0.77. It rarely fires after rewarded trials or when the agent leans toward a2. Magnitudes are small (max 0.019). I did not check what modulates magnitude beyond these coverage numbers, which stay flat across activation quartiles.
